item.title: How to connect SSIS to Azure SQL Database?
item.description:
Connecting to an Azure SQL database from SSIS is a great way to transfer data from on-premise systems to the cloud. Azure SQL databases offer a secure, scalable, and cost-effective database solution for your data needs. This article will provide a detailed overview on how to connect SSIS to an Azure SQL database, as well as some potential challenges you may encounter along the way.

Introduction of Azure SQL Database

Azure SQL Database is a cloud-based database service that provides organizations with a fully managed and reliable relational database platform. To ensure the secure and reliable operation of applications, it is important for organizations to have a secure connection to the Azure SQL Database.
